scientific_integrity: Full infinite strict-positive-definiteness theorem follows from an analytic consecutive-block Vandermonde argument; 1034 finite checker assertions are auxiliary only. No external independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the unit two-sphere; no uniform stability lower bound on colliding sites; the kernel is not characteristic to probability measures or universal on C(S^2); first-priority attribution remains best-knowledge.
title: A real-analytic strictly positive definite sphere kernel with one harmonic mode in every degree
